stock.description: Basetrophy Group Holdings Limited is an investment holding entity that primarily functions as a substructure subcontractor throughout Hong Kong. The company's diverse service portfolio encompasses various foundation works, including excavation and lateral support, a range of piling techniques such as sheet, pipe, pre-boring, pre-bored H, mini, and bored piling, alongside site preparation and other geotechnical engineering solutions like slope stabilization and shotcreting. Founded in 2003, its principal office is located in San Po Kong, Hong Kong. Basetrophy Group Holdings Limited is a subsidiary of Brightly Ahead Limited.
